entries.en: The person next to me[n]sure is yawning a lot...
It makes me want to yawn too...
It's today's news...

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: Physical abuse incident: police are now[n]questioning school officials and suspect[n]faculty covered up...

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: Pollen warning in effect starting this week.[n]Experts believe it will be the most severe[n]season in years.

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: Special report: the great artist Madarame,[n]master of Japanese art, will be holding an[n]exhibition...
The Kamoshida scandal[n]shocked the nation because[n]he was such a famous athlete...
Not to mention his sudden[n]change of heart...
I bet no one would believe[n]it's all because of us.
The woman next to me[n]won't stop sniffling...
She's pretty cute...
I'd love to give her a tissue,[n]but there's not enough room[n]to open my bag and get one.
It's today's news...

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: Investigators today issued a preliminary[n]report on the Ginza Line derailment,[n]citing poor management...

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: A new internet scam is on the rise,[n]with 80 percent of victims being[n]middle or high school students.

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: Weather report: Expect plenty of sun[n]on Saturday and Sunday, but folks with[n]pollen allergies...
...It sounds like the pollen is[n]going to be bad this weekend.
It'll be the perfect time to[n]strike Madarame, since his[n]meds'll put him out of whack.
That person's umbrella[n]keeps poking me...
I tried pushing it away,[n]but it won't budge!
Guess I'll just[n]deal with it...
It's today's news...

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: —one night since Madarame's public[n]apology, many have filed lawsuits over[n]the price of the art pieces—

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: —reports of extortion running rampant[n]in Shibuya believed to be ran by a[n]criminal organization—

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: —as the Kanto region enters its rainy[n]season, residents are warned to watch[n]for landslide conditions—
Madarame copped to[n]taking advantage of[n]his students...
Others in the art community[n]are stepping in to evaluate the work of the[n]artists he exploited...
...Despite what Akechi says,[n]we made the right choice.
This woman is leaning against[n]me with all her weight...
Can't risk... pushing back...[n]She might step on me... [n]in those stilettos...
...Might as well[n]just deal with it.
It's today's news...

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: —first new threat from the hacker[n]network in six months, perhaps made[n]to provoke the Phantom Thieves—

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: —multiple arrests from the mafia[n]organization responsible for the[n]string of scams in Shibuya—

entries.speaker: News
entries.en: —announced this year's theme for the[n]Suminoe Shrine Fireworks Festival:[n]the Milky Way—
...It's been six months since[n]the hackers last pulled a stunt.[n]Why are they active again now?
Something we did must[n]have stirred them up...
All the more reason not to let[n]them roam free. We need to[n]find a way to deal with them...
